{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Input is an object containing events, start, end, width and fill. Events contain string group, integer time and integer-or-null value. Output is an ordered list of group, start, count and value records.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["input and output"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Input and output use the specified JSON-compatible structure."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Input {events:[{group:string,time:int,value:int|null}],start:int,end:int,width:positive int,fill:'none'|'previous'}, start<=end.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Input schema."},
        {"quote": "Return [{group,start,count,value}] in group then bucket order.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Output schema."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "precondition",
      "role": "assumption",
      "statement": "The caller supplies input conforming to the stated schema, with positive integer width, start <= end and fill equal to none or previous.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["function invocation"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Input satisfies the stated types and domain constraints."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Input {events:[{group:string,time:int,value:int|null}],start:int,end:int,width:positive int,fill:'none'|'previous'}, start<=end.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Specified input domain."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Provide a pure deterministic Python 3 solve(data) function in solution.py that receives JSON-compatible Python input and returns a JSON-serializable result.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["solution.py", "solve(data)"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The function exists at the specified location.", "Equal inputs yield equal results.", "Calling the function has no observable side effects.", "The return value is JSON-serializable."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Implement solution.py with a pure solve(data) function.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required implementation interface and purity."},
        {"quote": "Implement a pure deterministic Python 3 function solve(data) in solution.py.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Language and determinism."},
        {"quote": "Input and output are JSON-compatible Python values.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Value compatibility."},
        {"quote": "The function receives a JSON value and returns a JSON-serializable value.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Serialization contract."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "resource_constraint",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Use only the Python standard library and perform no external I/O.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["implementation and execution"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["No third-party libraries are required.", "Execution performs no external I/O."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Use Python standard library only, no external I/O.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Dependency and I/O restrictions."},
        {"quote": "Use only the standard library, no external I/O.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Repeated restrictions."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Select all distinct event group names, including names whose events are entirely outside the range, and order groups lexicographically.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["group selection"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Selected groups equal the set of event group names.", "Groups appear in lexicographic order.", "An empty events list produces no groups."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Groups are all unique event group names sorted lexicographically, including groups with no in-range events.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Group membership and ordering."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O3",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every selected group, emit one bucket for every start + k*width strictly below end, for nonnegative integer k. Each bucket covers [bucketStart, min(bucketStart+width,end)).",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["bucket generation and event membership"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}, {"id": "O2", "relation": "uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Bucket starts follow the specified arithmetic progression.", "Lower endpoints are included and upper endpoints excluded.", "The final bucket is clipped at end.", "start = end emits no buckets."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "For each group, emit buckets starting start,start+width,...", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Bucket progression."},
        {"quote": "strictly below end, each covering [bucketStart,min(bucketStart+width,end)).", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Bucket limits and half-open intervals."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O4",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Within each group and bucket, sum and count exactly the non-null event values whose times belong to that bucket. Count duplicate events separately. A bucket is nonempty exactly when this count is positive, and its value is its sum, including a sum of zero.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["bucket aggregation"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "O3", "relation": "uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Null values contribute neither to sum nor count.", "Out-of-range events contribute neither to sum nor count.", "Duplicate occurrences each contribute.", "Positive count implies value equals the integer sum even when zero."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Sum only non-null in-range values;", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Aggregation eligibility."},
        {"quote": "count counts these values.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Count semantics."},
        {"quote": "A nonempty bucket has value=sum and becomes previous value.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Nonempty bucket output."},
        {"quote": "Zero sum is a real previous value, duplicates are counted.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Zero and duplicate semantics."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "invariant",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For each group independently, previous starts absent and tracks the sum of the latest earlier nonempty emitted bucket. Processing a nonempty bucket updates previous to its sum, including zero; processing an empty bucket preserves previous. Events before start never initialize previous.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["per-group causal filling state"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "O4", "relation": "uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Previous is absent before the first nonempty bucket.", "Previous never crosses group boundaries.", "Empty buckets do not change previous.", "A zero sum is retained as previous.", "Pre-start events never seed previous."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "A nonempty bucket has value=sum and becomes previous value.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "State update."},
        {"quote": "empty buckets never reset previous.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "State preservation."},
        {"quote": "Events before start never seed previous.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Causal initialization boundary."},
        {"quote": "Zero sum is a real previous value, duplicates are counted.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Zero is retained."},
        {"quote": "For each group, emit buckets starting start,start+width,...", "origin": "inferred", "interpretation": "Previous is maintained separately for each group.", "justification": "Filling is part of each group's bucket sequence, so another group's aggregate cannot supply its previous value."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O5",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For an empty bucket, return count zero and value null in fill none mode. In fill previous mode, return the latest previous nonempty bucket sum, or null when none exists.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["empty bucket output"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "I1", "relation": "uses_proof"}, {"id": "O4", "relation": "uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Empty buckets always have count zero.", "fill none yields null for every empty bucket.", "fill previous yields the previous nonempty sum when available and otherwise null."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Empty bucket value is null for fill none, or latest previous nonempty bucket sum for fill previous (null before first);", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Empty bucket filling."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O6",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Return the specified list of records in lexicographic group order and ascending bucket-start order within each group, preserving the specified structure.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["returned result"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "O2", "relation": "uses_proof"}, {"id": "O3", "relation": "uses_proof"}, {"id": "O4", "relation": "uses_proof"}, {"id": "O5", "relation": "uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Each record contains group, start, count and value.", "The list follows group then bucket order exactly."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Return [{group,start,count,value}] in group then bucket order.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Return format and order."},
        {"quote": "Preserve the specified input/output structure and exact ordering.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact structural contract."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O7",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Reproduce both public examples: the a group's cancelling values produce count 2 and value 0 at start 0 followed by empty buckets at starts 2 and 4 retaining zero; the z group's pre-start event produces an empty bucket at start 0 with count 0 and null value.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["public examples"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "O6", "relation": "uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The first example returns the three specified a records.", "The second example returns the specified z record."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Zero sum is a real previous value, duplicates are counted.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "First example's zero filling."},
        {"quote": "Events before start never seed previous.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Second example's absent previous."},
        {"quote": "[{\"input\": {\"end\": 5, \"events\": [{\"group\": \"a\", \"time\": 0, \"value\": 2}, {\"group\": \"a\", \"time\": 1, \"value\": -2}], \"fill\": \"previous\", \"start\": 0, \"width\": 2}, \"output\": [{\"count\": 2, \"group\": \"a\", \"start\": 0, \"value\": 0}, {\"count\": 0, \"group\": \"a\", \"start\": 2, \"value\": 0}, {\"count\": 0, \"group\": \"a\", \"start\": 4, \"value\": 0}]}, {\"input\": {\"end\": 1, \"events\": [{\"group\": \"z\", \"time\": -1, \"value\": 9}], \"fill\": \"previous\", \"start\": 0, \"width\": 2}, \"output\": [{\"count\": 0, \"group\": \"z\", \"start\": 0, \"value\": null}]}]", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact public input/output examples."}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "category_review": {
    "entities": "Input event records and ordered bucket output records.",
    "preconditions": "Caller supplies the explicitly specified input domain.",
    "postconditions": "Pure deterministic interface, group selection, bucket generation, aggregation, filling, ordering and public examples.",
    "invariants": "Per-group previous tracks the latest nonempty bucket sum and survives empty buckets.",
    "safety_properties": "No separate safety property stated.",
    "liveness_properties": "None stated.",
    "resource_constraints": "Standard library only and no external I/O.",
    "error_semantics": "Invalid-input behavior is not specified; guarantees concern the stated domain.",
    "explicit_non_goals": "None stated.",
    "ambiguities": "None affecting the specified behavior."
  },
  "clauses": [
    {"clause_id": "C1", "quote": "Software engineering task D21: Grouped bucket aggregation with causal filling", "disposition": "context", "refs": [], "note": "Task title."},
    {"clause_id": "C2", "quote": "Implement solution.py with a pure solve(data) function.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C3", "quote": "Input and output are JSON-compatible Python values.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C4", "quote": "Use Python standard library only, no external I/O.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["R1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C5", "quote": "Input {events:[{group:string,time:int,value:int|null}],start:int,end:int,width:positive int,fill:'none'|'previous'}, start<=end.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "A1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C6", "quote": "Groups are all unique event group names sorted lexicographically, including groups with no in-range events.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C7", "quote": "For each group, emit buckets starting start,start+width,...", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O3"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C8", "quote": "strictly below end, each covering [bucketStart,min(bucketStart+width,end)).", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O3"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C9", "quote": "Sum only non-null in-range values;", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O4"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C10", "quote": "count counts these values.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O4"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C11", "quote": "A nonempty bucket has value=sum and becomes previous value.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O4", "I1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C12", "quote": "Empty bucket value is null for fill none, or latest previous nonempty bucket sum for fill previous (null before first);", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O5"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C13", "quote": "empty buckets never reset previous.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["I1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C14", "quote": "Events before start never seed previous.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["I1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C15", "quote": "Return [{group,start,count,value}] in group then bucket order.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O6"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C16", "quote": "Zero sum is a real previous value, duplicates are counted.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O4", "I1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C17", "quote": "Implement a pure deterministic Python 3 function solve(data) in solution.py.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C18", "quote": "Use only the standard library, no external I/O.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["R1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C19", "quote": "The function receives a JSON value and returns a JSON-serializable value.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C20", "quote": "Preserve the specified input/output structure and exact ordering.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O6"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C21", "quote": "Public examples (additional held-out cases will be scored):\n[{\"input\": {\"end\": 5, \"events\": [{\"group\": \"a\", \"time\": 0, \"value\": 2}, {\"group\": \"a\", \"time\": 1, \"value\": -2}], \"fill\": \"previous\", \"start\": 0, \"width\": 2}, \"output\": [{\"count\": 2, \"group\": \"a\", \"start\": 0, \"value\": 0}, {\"count\": 0, \"group\": \"a\", \"start\": 2, \"value\": 0}, {\"count\": 0, \"group\": \"a\", \"start\": 4, \"value\": 0}]}, {\"input\": {\"end\": 1, \"events\": [{\"group\": \"z\", \"time\": -1, \"value\": 9}], \"fill\": \"previous\", \"start\": 0, \"width\": 2}, \"output\": [{\"count\": 0, \"group\": \"z\", \"start\": 0, \"value\": null}]}]", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O7"], "note": "Examples constrain behavior; the held-out scoring statement supplies evaluation context."}
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    {"id": "A1", "supplied_by": "caller", "discharged_at": "solve(data) invocation by supplying an object satisfying the specified schema and domain constraints"}
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "selected_defaults": []
}
